final: SELECT g.equipref, g.avg_artifacts, g.avg_artifacts - o.overall_avg AS avg_minus_overall, g.avg_artifacts / k.kept_avg AS avg_divided_by_kept_avg FROM (SELECT equipref, AVG(articount) AS avg_artifacts FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY equipref) AS g CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_artifacts) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT equipref, AVG(articount) AS avg_artifacts FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY equipref)) AS o CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_artifacts) AS kept_avg FROM (SELECT equipref, AVG(articount) AS avg_artifacts FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY equipref) AS groups_with_avg CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_artifacts) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT equipref, AVG(articount) AS avg_artifacts FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY equipref)) AS overall WHERE groups_with_avg.avg_artifacts > overall.overall_avg) AS k WHERE g.avg_artifacts > o.overall_avg ORDER BY (g.avg_artifacts / k.kept_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
